scope: Encoded: s 120B(a), (b), (d), (e)(1)-(2) as a mechanism over supplied index readings and amounts, for adjustments from 1 January 2025; s 121(a)(1)-(3) and (b)(1)(a)-(d), (b)(2) with the figures the text prints, for tax years 2026 and 2027; s 121B(a), (a1), (b), (d) (as an input convention) and (e) with both definitions, for tax years from 2026 with the (a) amount supplied, residential-apartment sales only for 2026. Inert: s 120B(c) (repealed), s 121B(c), the editorial notes after s 121. Out of scope: s 121A (repealed; row IL-08). Used as inputs, not encoded: credit points ss 33A-36A (row IL-01), s 66 (row IL-02), the special-rate sections, s 8(c), the Real Estate Taxation Law, and the rounding Order 5746-1986 made under s 120B(d). Every other tax year is declined by a named REFUSE. See NOTES.md sections 1-3.

tax_years_answered.s 121B: 2026 onward, with the s 121B(a) amount supplied; a residential-apartment sale only in 2026; from 0.2.0 the s 121B(e) helpers decline 2025 as the rule does

forks.F1: s 121(b)(1): which shekels of the scale the eligible income occupies beside other income. Ruled by Meng 2026-10-08 (SHRUG), from 0.3.0 a switch: the eligible income at the bottom (0.1.0 to 0.2.0), the other income at the bottom, pro rata, and by default declined where the placement changes the tax.
forks.F2: s 121(b)(1): on what day 'has reached 60' is tested. Ruled by Meng 2026-10-08 (SHRUG), from 0.3.0 a switch: 60 by the end of the tax year (0.1.0 to 0.2.0), 60 by the start, only the income derived after the 60th birthday (declines where that would matter: not an input), and by default declined where the day changes the tax.
forks.F3: s 121(b)(2) reaches any eligible income, including an over-60 individual's income not from personal exertion.
forks.F4: s 120B(a)-(b): whether a fall of the index lowers the amounts. Ruled by Meng 2026-10-08 (SHRUG), as IL-04 F6 (TRIDENT) for the same words: from 0.3.0 a switch, the fall applied (0.1.0 to 0.2.0), the amount stays where it was, and by default a fall declined; a rise or no change is the same under all three.
forks.F5: s 120B(e)(2): the 2028 adjustment uses the 2027 rise only; 2024-2026 inflation is not recovered. 0.3.0: classed (b) under SHRUG, not a switch: only this reading is arguable on the words ('the index of tax year 2027' in place of (a)'s 'the index in the previous tax year'), the independent pass reached it separately, and the amount in force for 2028 is declined anyway (rounding Order). This session's judgment, not a ruling.
forks.F6: s 120B(a): the chain carries unrounded figures; only the figure in force is rounded.
forks.F7: s 120B(e)(2) with the 5786 amendment of s 121: answered at 0.2.0 by s 7 of the enacted 5786 Economic Efficiency Law (deposited, a862cb5): the amounts its chapter states are regarded as the amounts adjusted to 1 January 2024, so their 2028 base is the stated figure (reading (iii), which comes to (ii)); before or after rounding, s 7 supplies one figure for each, the one (e)(2) restarts from. No answer changes: s 121 from 2028 is still declined, for want of the 2027 index and the rounding Order. (0.1.0: not determined; s 121 from 2028 declined.)
forks.F8: s 121(a)(1) and (b)(1)(d) print the same top of the 31% band; supplied ceilings in which they differ are declined.
forks.F9: s 121B(e): the 'not exempt' condition belongs to the residential limb only; an uncounted sale contributes nothing, its inflationary amount included.
forks.F10: s 121B(e): the residential threshold is that of the case's tax year.
forks.F11: s 121B(a1) 'ממקורות הוניים' is read as the term (e) defines.
forks.F12: s 1 'שנת מס': special assessment periods are not modelled.
forks.F15: Betterment under the Real Estate Taxation Law is capital-source income for s 121B(a1).
forks.F16: No rounding of income or tax to whole shekels.
forks.F17: s 120B(e)(1) also stops a mid-year s 120B(b) adjustment in 2025-2027.
